basic_details.scholarship_name: Chalmers University of Technology IPOET Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Chalmers University of Technology & Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Master's programmes across all engineering departments, with emphasis on Computer Science and Engineering: Computer Science - algorithms, languages and logic, Computer Systems and Networks, Data Science and AI, High-Performance Computer Systems, and Software Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~45 to 55 tuition waivers (75% or 100% waiver) awarded annually across all master's programmes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani STEM graduates secure ~3 to 6 tuition waivers annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (120 ECTS credits), subject to achieving at least 45 ECTS credits in Year 1

nationality_requirements: Citizens of non-EU/EEA countries liable to pay tuition fees in Sweden
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.40 / 4.00 or 78%+ aggregate; top 10-15% of class preferred).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Chalmers evaluates academic excellence weighted by the prestige and grading standard of the home institution.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial coursework in mathematics (calculus, linear algebra, discrete math) and core computer science (data structures, algorithms, computer systems).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final-year undergraduate students graduating before autumn enrollment are eligible to apply conditionally.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; relevant internships and technical projects strengthen the application profile.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5 (no section below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT min 90 (written test min 20). Medium of Instruction letters not accepted for Pakistani degrees.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must designate Chalmers as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with Swedish Institute (SI) scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 75% to 100% tuition fee reduction covering full tuition for the 2-year Master's degree (SEK 310,000 to SEK 360,000 value; ~USD 30,000 to 35,000). (Students with top performance in Year 1 receive 85% or 100% in Year 2).

admission_application_fee.details: Swedish national application fee of SEK 900 paid online via Universityadmissions.se.

accommodation.details: Student housing through SGS Studentbostäder or Chalmers Studentbostäder (CSB); single rooms or studio flats average SEK 4,200 to 6,500/month.

monthly_stipend.details: The IPOET scholarship covers tuition fees only; living expenses (~SEK 10,314/month required by Swedish Migration Agency) must be covered from personal or family funds.

airfare.details: Travel between Pakistan and Gothenburg Landvetter (GOT) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Swedish Residence Permit for Higher Education application fee of SEK 1,500 paid to Migrationsverket.

health_insurance.details: Covered by the Swedish state collective insurance for fee-paying students (FAS+) covering medical and emergency care.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free access to electronic course textbooks via Chalmers Library, computer labs, and engineering software.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental travel grants available for master's thesis research presented at academic conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to SEK 8,000 per conference presentation

travel_transit_allowance.details: Västtrafik student discount provides reduced fares across Gothenburg trams, buses, and ferries.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Student discount on Gothenburg regional transit

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single renowned Swedish technical university: Chalmers University of Technology (Gothenburg, Sweden)
participating_institutions: Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE - shared with Univ of Gothenburg)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 150 global university (QS World #139, THE World #189); leader in automotive computing, AI (Volvo/Ericsson industrial partnership), and quantum engineering.
available_majors: Master's Programme in Computer Science - algorithms, languages and logic
Master's Programme in Computer Systems and Networks
Master's Programme in Data Science and AI
Master's Programme in High-Performance Computer Systems
Master's Programme in Software Engineering and Technology
Master's Programme in Embedded Electronic System Design
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS in CS/STEM with 3.4+ GPA, transcripts, CV, and IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+. Chalmers must be selected as Priority 1.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Data Science & AI and Computer Science are highly competitive; Software Engineering, Computer Systems and Networks, and High-Performance Computing have slightly higher admit rates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: You must rank Chalmers as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se to be considered for IPOET scholarship funding.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Apply for Chalmers as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se, then fill out the Chalmers Scholarship form on chalmers.se using your 8-digit application number.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - January): Apply for Chalmers Master's programme as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se.
Step 2 (By mid-January): Pay the Swedish national application fee of SEK 900.
Step 3 (Early December - Mid January): Access the Chalmers Scholarship application form on chalmers.se.
Step 4 (In Chalmers portal): Input your 8-digit application number, select scholarship, and submit your motivation statement.
Step 5 (By 1 February): Upload all transcripts, degree certificates, and English test scores to Universityadmissions.se.
Step 6 (Late March): Swedish national admissions results published.
Step 7 (Early April): Chalmers Scholarship decisions communicated via email.
Step 8 (April - June): Apply for Swedish Residence Permit for Higher Education via Migrationsverket.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Two-step application: Programme admission applied via Universityadmissions.se; IPOET Scholarship applied via dedicated form on chalmers.se.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Not required for Chalmers admissions or IPOET scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Chalmers Scholarship motivation essay detailing academic background, why Chalmers was selected as Priority 1, and long-term career goals.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1-2 page academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, capstone projects, and distinctions.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions are based purely on academic merit and motivation evaluation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified scans uploaded to Universityadmissions.se; HEC attestation recommended.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: National application on Universityadmissions.se + scholarship form on chalmers.se.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copy of original degree certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS degree; HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured statement of motivation submitted through the online scholarship form.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Articulate why Chalmers is your top choice and highlight technical alignment with target engineering track.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page CV detailing academic background, technical skills, projects, and honors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight final-year project (FYP) and technical tools.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic TRF (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT score report (90+) sent to University Admissions in Sweden.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must satisfy Swedish English 6 requirement; institutional MOI letters are not accepted for Pakistani degrees.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport bio-data page.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure passport is valid for at least 2 years beyond intended arrival.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake for autumn semester. Chalmers must be designated as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 65% (Cumulative GPA, performance in advanced mathematics and computer science courses, university prestige)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Scholarship motivation essay evaluating alignment with Chalmers)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Chalmers Central Scholarship Committee and Department of Computer Science and Engineering Academic Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Point-based merit ranking: Applicants are scored primarily on relative academic excellence (weighted GPA and home university standing) followed by qualitative review of the motivation essay. Scholarships awarded in strict rank order.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 3,800+ fee-paying international applicants across Chalmers Master's programmes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~45 to 55 tuition fee waivers awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 3% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/EE from top Pakistani institution (FAST, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET), top 10% of class, high scores in algorithms and systems, IELTS 7.5+.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, Pakistan, Turkey, United States, Iran, Indonesia

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging fees for Chalmers scholarship placement. Applications must be submitted directly via Universityadmissions.se and chalmers.se.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Swedish national application fee of SEK 900 paid only via Universityadmissions.se. Chalmers scholarship application itself is free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Chalmers does not collaborate with education recruitment agents. Plagiarized statements of purpose result in disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Swedish Residence Permit application fee: SEK 1,500 (~PKR 39,000).
Living cost proof required by Swedish Migration Agency: SEK 10,314 / month (~PKR 268,000 / month; SEK 103,140 for 10-month bank statement = ~PKR 2,680,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Gothenburg: ~PKR 250,000 to 380,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: The IPOET scholarship covers living expenses. (FACT: The IPOET scholarship covers tuition fees only; living costs must be self-funded).
CLAIM: You can apply for IPOET with Chalmers as your second or third priority. (FACT: Chalmers must be your Priority 1 choice on Universityadmissions.se).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online blogs state that IPOET covers 100% for all winners. In fact, some recipients receive 75% fee waivers in Year 1, which may be upgraded to 85% or 100% in Year 2 based on academic performance.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must achieve at least 45 ECTS credits during the first academic year to retain the tuition waiver for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical enrollment on campus in Gothenburg.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual credit completion check by Chalmers Scholarships Office before renewing the waiver.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Swedish residence permit allows international students to work without hourly limits, provided satisfactory academic progress is maintained.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for a 1-year residence permit to seek employment or start a business in Sweden.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously waived tuition; failure to achieve 45 ECTS results in loss of waiver for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing programme requires formal application during the next admission cycle.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for the nominal 2-year duration (120 ECTS) and cannot be extended.
